title: Unexplained 10-minute delay on rescue flight off Cape Canaveral
summary: Greg Rogers tells of Unexplained 10-minute delay on rescue flight off Cape Canaveral, about c. 1989-1993 at The Atlantic Ocean, and says they saw it or took part. As told, not a fact.
place_text: About 130 miles off the 110 radial from Cape Canaveral, Atlantic Ocean

tellings.quote: um we were 10 minutes later than what we expected.

plain: Greg Rogers, a doctor who worked with NASA, the US space agency, says that sometime between 1989 and 1993 he was on a rescue flight over the Atlantic, about 130 miles out from Cape Canaveral in Florida. He says they arrived 10 minutes later than expected, and no one could explain why. If true, it would point to time the crew could not account for.
